criteria.description: Returns the canonical answer string, the compound label, and score 6 of 6.
criteria.name: Final label and score
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for the correct label with an incorrect score or missing canonical answer string; give 1 point for a plausible compound label without the diagnostic result.

criteria.description: Computes Daman 517.0 mm, primary grid maximum 73.33 mm, ratio 7.05, 25 record-setting stations, and 105 stations over 200 mm.
criteria.name: Rainfall concentration and breadth
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points if most rainfall values are correct but one formula, threshold comparison, or station-bin sum is missing; give 1 point for only identifying heavy rainfall qualitatively.

criteria.description: Computes five gauges above historic height and identifies Narayani River at Devghat as the largest exceedance at 3.52 m.
criteria.name: River-stage calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for the correct count or largest station alone, or for values with minor rounding errors.

criteria.description: Passes the landslide signal, flood exposure scale, and Kathmandu local exposure tests using 300 km2, 115000 people, 46000 Kathmandu people, and 5000 structures.
criteria.name: Landslide and exposure tests
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points when either the landslide signal or one exposure scale is missing; give 1 point for exposure values that are present but not tied to thresholds.

criteria.description: Applies score >= 5 with landslide_signal true and explains why river-only flooding is insufficient for the full diagnostic.
criteria.name: Decision rule and river-only check
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for the right final label with an incomplete decision rule or a weak river-only check.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON and does not add extra casualty, road-loss, facility-damage, or slope-area values not computed by the diagnostic.
criteria.name: Compact output and bounded inference
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for a mostly compact answer with minor extra prose or nonessential fields.
